item.title: SEBI Notifies New Merchant Banker Regulations, Mandates Higher Net-Worth and Liquidity Norms [Read Notification]
item.description: New measures ensure that merchant bankers cannot function as lead managers in matters in which their senior management people or associated parties have large shareholdings, eliminating conflict-of-interest problems.

item.title: 16,000 Litre Spirit Seizure: Patna HC Grants Anticipatory Bail to Lady Civic Volunteer [Read Order]
item.description: The Court noted her antecedents in two similar cases but accepted her plea that she was not apprehended at the spot, and nothing was recovered from her possession. Bail was granted subject to conditions under Section 438(2) CrPC.

item.title: ITR Processing and Refund Delayed: Taxpayers Turn to ‘X’, Demands Immediate Action
item.description: The official handle of the Income Tax India (@IncomeTaxIndia) witnessed a lot of replies demanding urgent intervention and clarity on the status of their pending claims.

item.title: 1035 Litres Liquor Seizure: Patna HC Allows Provisional Anticipatory Bail, Orders Antecedent Check Before Confirmation [Read Order]
item.description: The Court noted that neither petitioner was arrested on the spot and their implication was based on a co‑accused’s custodial confession

item.title: 58g Gold Chain Seized from Saudi Passenger, No SCN issued: Delhi HC Orders Fresh Personal Hearing [Read Order]
item.description: The Court ruled that printed waivers cannot replace a statutory SCN

item.title: Rajasthan HC Denies Bail to Accused Carrying 15.74 Kg Hydroponic Weed; Holds NDPS Act Overrides Customs Act in Airport Seizures [Read Order]
item.description: The court also clarified that in cases involving narcotic substances seized in a customs area, the Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1985 (NDPS Act), being a special statute, assumes overriding effect over the Customs Act, 1962, by virtue of Section 80 of the NDPS Act.

item.title: Concrete Mix Produced at Metro Site not Excisable as RMC: CESTAT Sets Aside Duty and Penalties [Read Order]
item.description: The Tribunal held that even if manufacture were assumed, the concrete produced at the site was fully exempt under Notification No. 12/2012-CE.

item.title: No Retrospective Application of Amendment Mandating 18% Interest on Profiteered Amount: GSTAT Upholds DGAP’s Findings, Directs Deposit of ₹4.57 Lakh [Read Order]
item.description: The Tribunal clarified that the amendment cannot be applicable retrospectively, prior to its commencement date

item.title: Electricity Regulatory Commissions are not Suppliers: Karnataka HC Quashes ₹13.42 Cr GST Demand on KERC [Read Order]
item.description: The Karnataka High Court acceded to a Delhi High Court ruling where it was held that statutory electricity regulators do not render “supply” under the GST law.
